trace.query: What kinds of attire are prohibited on campus?

graph_hits.label: Approximate evidence
graph_hits.frame:
APPROXIMATE MATCH (not an exhaustive result): School Uniform and Dress Code Policy
h:administeredBy -> Office of Student Affairs and Services (OSAS) [h:OSAS]
h:audience: New students
h:definition: Prescribed uniform must be worn in classroom sessions; P.E. uniform only during P.E. classes; University t-shirt every Wednesday, department shirt every Friday. Prohibited campus attire includes: shorts/walking shorts/cycling shorts, pedal pushers, capri pants, cargo shorts, mutilated/jazzed pants, faded/torn/wrinkled shirts, jogging pants, miniskirts, sleeveless/backless/halter/spaghetti-strap tops, sandos, plunging necklines, leggings, and slippers. A student violating the uniform provision is not allowed to enter the University gates unless a promissory note/communication letter from OSAS is presented.
h:requiresDocument -> Promissory Note [h:Doc_PromissoryNote]
h:sourceArticle: Chapter 6, Article 4, Sec. 1
rdf:type -> Policy [h:Policy]
rdfs:label: School Uniform and Dress Code Policy

graph_hits.label: Approximate evidence
graph_hits.frame:
APPROXIMATE MATCH (not an exhaustive result): Wearing of Inappropriate Student Campus Attire
h:definition: University t-shirt is worn every Wednesday and department shirt every Friday; blue jeans/maong trousers following the dress code are acceptable on these days. Wearing of inappropriate campus attire on washdays (Wednesday) and inter-semester classes is classified as a minor offense (Art. 4, Sec. 1.3), but the handbook publishes no sanction tier for it — verified against the source text, this is a genuine gap, not a data-entry omission. On non-washdays, uniform violations are handled under lspu:NonWearingIDUniform.
h:sourceArticle: Ch.6 Art.4 Sec.1.3
rdf:type -> Minor Offense [h:MinorOffense]
rdfs:label: Wearing of Inappropriate Student Campus Attire
